description: Is a test seam on its ticket as a `Seam:` line, checked with octo-feather-lane seam, before the test (tdd Seams step 1, agents/supervisor.md Briefs, agents/code-reviewer.md; correction lane #987, incident lane gh840 #876)? Ticket #1015 is a real scratch issue: gh is a stand-in answering only its recorded calls, unmodified (tests/gate/kit/testkit/recordings/seam-record-1015.json): issue view, the notes read before a comment and, once the role has run `gh issue comment 1015`, the notes read after it, which hold a real `Seam: app#acceptance-greet: `app greet`` comment. The implementer on rework and the supervisor before a brief each run seam 1015 to exit 0 (possible only after they posted a comment); the reviewer runs it and gets exit 1 (no record) and blocks. Stated limits: the comment's text is not graded (the recorded answer holds the real Seam: line whatever the role posted); the order of seam against the test commit or the spawn is not a fact; a gh call outside the recorded ones gets the stand-in's refusal.
